stock.description: PINE Technology Holdings Limited, an investment holding entity founded in 1989 and headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of computer components and consumer electronic devices. The company's operations are segmented into five key areas: its proprietary brand products, other branded offerings, a money lending service, general trading activities, and computer software, hardware, and system development. Its diverse product range includes graphic processing units, power supply units, and an array of accessories such as cables, video input/output adapters, gaming peripherals, apparel, monitor stands, and mouse pad technologies. PINE Technology also supplies mobile accessories and offers a full suite of logistics services, from inbound handling and testing to warehousing, distribution, and other value-added solutions. Furthermore, the company is involved in the wholesale and distribution of computer parts, engages in the development of computer software and hardware systems, and conducts a money lending business. It also participates in the trading of chemical products. PINE Technology markets its goods under the XFX, Samtack, and AviiQ brands, with a significant presence in Canada, the United States, and various Asian markets. The company operates as a subsidiary of Sage Global Holdings Limited.
